title: amanda-jones-private-deploy-scratchpad-2026-03-10
content:
Daily scratchpad - private deployment field notes
Owner: Amanda Jones
Date: 2026-03-10
Context: Onsite kick-off with ACME Corp. VPC/on-prem install for pilot (3-node GPU cluster). Notes to self + blockers + short TODO list. Mostly shorthand.

---
Call summary (09:30 PST):
- Quick sync with ACME infra (Luis, Priya) re: network, KMS, and firewall rules.
- Agreed initial scope: deploy control plane in customer VPC (private subnets), worker nodes in their on-prem rack accessible via VPN to control plane.
- Next touchpoint Wed 3/11 to validate IAM policies and cert rotation plan.

Immediate TODOs (prioritized):
- [ ] Confirm customer provides: NTP, DNS entries, and reachable KMS endpoint (deadline: 3/11)
- [ ] Share minimal iptables / firewall list for outbound ports (443, 10250, 9000) + ephemeral ports for KV cache sync
- [ ] Generate certs and CA bundle; upload to ACME S3 (or handoff via secure transfer)
- [ ] Create INF-2345 ticket with install runbook + rollback steps (w/ Miguel)
- [ ] Run preflight script on customer subnet (see commands below)

Preflight checklist (notes):
- Networking:
  - Private subnets with NAT for outbound to Redwood control plane? Customer prefers no NAT. Need to validate routing to our control plane IPs.
  - VPN tunnel (IPSec) tests: latency < 25ms, MTU 1400 recommended
  - Firewall: allow outbound to control-plane endpoints on 443 and TCP 9000 (metrics), allow NTP (123) to their NTP server
- Security:
  - KMS reachable from control plane; key policy should allow Redwood service principal (TBD: IAM ARN)
  - HSM not available on their side; plan for envelope encryption with remote KMS
- Host prep:
  - OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS preferred
  - Kernel: ensure AHV modules present for RDMA if using InfiniBand (customer said IB on GPU hosts)
  - Docker/container runtime: containerd 1.6+
- Time sync: epic blocker if not configured -> ensure chrony/ntpd pointed to their internal NTP

Commands / quick runbook snippets (run as root):
- Preflight network test: curl -v https://control-plane.redwood.internal/health || echo "control-plane not reachable"
- Check ports: nc -zv control-plane.redwood.internal 443; nc -zv <metrics-host> 9000
- Disk check: lsblk; sudo fdisk -l; make sure /var/lib is on >1TB for KV cache

Known customer constraints / reminders:
- ACME IT team enforces strict egress filtering; we must provide explicit IPs/subnets for control-plane and metrics endpoints.
- No outbound SSH allowed to worker nodes from internet; jump host needed for debugging.
- Patch window Mon-Fri 02:00-04:00 local time; avoid restarts in that window.

Blockers & Risks:
- Pending: KMS policy (ACME must add Redwood service principal). Without it, can't enable envelope encryption -> compliance risk.
- Pending: Network reachability for metrics (they only allow metric push to internal aggregator). We may need to forward metrics via VPN or use an aggregator sidecar.
- Customer uses older BIOS on one rack; GPU firmware mismatch could block driver install (ticketed: HW-compat-78).

Decisions / notes to capture for runbook:
- Use private endpoint mode (no public control plane) for this pilot. Document steps to flip to public if necessary.
- Default quantization profile for pilot: int8-qat (recommended by applied-ml). Note: requires CUDA 12+ drivers.

Follow-ups (owners):
- Miguel: Draft KMS policy template + sample IAM binding (due 3/11)
- Riley: Prepare minimal firewall/IP list and upload to INF-2345 (due EOD 3/10)
- Amanda (me): Create cert bundle, run preflight script, coordinate with ACME jump host (complete before 3/11 call)

Random notes / to-self:
- Remember to add Confluence link to private-deploy-guide-v2 and include section on cert rotation automation.
- Check GHA secret rotation schedule -> ensure our deploy tool uses short-lived creds when possible.
- If IB present, coordinate with infra SRE (Samira) to enable hugepages and update kernel args.

End-of-day status: preflight script ran locally against their VPN endpoint - some ports blocked (9000), reached out to Priya for firewall exception. KMS test timed out (need endpoint and TLS cert).

---
Short log snippets (for copying into ticket):
- Preflight: curl https://control-plane.redwood.internal/health -> SSL handshake timeout
- nc -zv control-plane.redwood.internal 9000 -> connection refused (likely firewall)
- ssh to jump-host.amce.local -> OK (used to upload cert bundle)

Attachments to include when creating INF-2345: preflight-output.log, cert-bundle.tar.enc, network-diagram-v1.png (ask customer for latest), BIOS-compat-list.csv

Notes end.
